The '''Tammuz-an capital city''' was the center of administration of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tammuz-an/Legends|Tammuz-an]].

==History==
This city was the location of the [[Royal castle|castle]] from where the [[Tammuz-an (species)/Legends|Tammuz-an]] royalty maintained their rule. Other notable buildings included a [[Tammuz-an spaceport|spaceport]], the medical ward [[Unit B-6]] and the [[Tower (Tammuz-an Royal castle)|royal tower]] where traditional crowning ceremony took place.
